label: Technical Editorial
description: Production package for a strict-grid technical explanatory family with original rules, annotation rails, code/data callouts, review fixtures, and deterministic Remotion artifacts.

renderCost.notes: Grid rules, diagram cards, and code rails are deterministic but denser than the shared core fixture.

reducedMotion.notes: Dense and edge fixtures switch to reduced or static entrance behavior while preserving the full visual grammar.

accessibility.notes: High-contrast type, restrained accent usage, and fixed safe-area margins keep review frames readable.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Choose when narration depends on labeled structure, explicit evidence, and inspectable technical terminology.

sourcePolicy.notes: The family uses original Lucida layout grammar and text-only primitives. No third-party logos, screenshots, fonts, or copied brand assets are registered.

tokens.palette: deep-neutral canvas with cool blue annotation accents and warm warning markers
tokens.typography: UI sans for headings and body, monospace only for code/data evidence
tokens.surface: sharp card edges, low-radius panels, and explicit rule lines

layoutGrammar: Use a strict 12-column portrait grid with visible rule structure.
Reserve narrow annotation rails for caveats, evidence, and metadata.
Keep the central panel for the main diagram or mechanism flow.
Use code and metric callouts only when they substantively support the main claim.
Avoid decorative illustration, copied product UI, or floating text without a surface.

componentPrimitives.notes: Narrow evidence lane for objective, guardrail, and QA notes.
Primary mechanism surface with fixed node cards and labeled connectors.
Monospace evidence surface for render instructions, reports, or structured snippets.

knownLimitations: Shared registry availability wiring remains outside this ownership slice, so the family package is not switched from placeholder in shared registry files.
Only 9:16 review frames were rendered in this task; 16:9 remains metadata-ready but unrendered.
